import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v, flow, capacity;
        Edge(int u, int v, int flow, int capacity) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static final long INF = 1000000009L;
    static int source, sink;
    static List<List<Integer>> graph;
    static List<Edge> edges;
    static int[] ptr = new int[1001];
    static int[] dist = new int[1001];

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
        graph.get(u).add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity));
        graph.get(v).add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static boolean bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int idx : graph.get(u)) {
                Edge e = edges.get(idx);
                if (dist[e.v] == -1 && e.flow < e.capacity) {
                    dist[e.v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.v);
                    if (e.v == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long dfs(int u, long flow) {
        if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            int idx = graph.get(u).get(i);
            Edge e = edges.get(idx);
            if (dist[e.v] != dist[u] + 1) continue;
            long pushed = dfs(e.v, Math.min(flow, (long)e.capacity - e.flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.flow += pushed;
                edges.get(idx ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long dinic() {
        long totalFlow = 0;
        while (bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = dfs(source, INF)) > 0) {
                totalFlow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static String[] scientists = new String[101];
    static String[] reactors = new String[101];
    static int[][][] reach = new int[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] vis = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] unusable = new int[10][10];
    static int N, M;

    static boolean inBounds(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < N && c < M;
    }

    static int nodeID(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + M * x + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        N = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int T = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        ++T;
        M = N;
        sink = M * M * 2 + 1;
        source = 0;
        graph = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < M * M * 2 + 2; i++) {
            graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        edges = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            scientists[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            reactors[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                unusable[i][j] = INF;
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    unusable[i][j] = 1;
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = q.poll();
                        int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
                        for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                            for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                                if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                                    int nx = x + di, ny = y + dj;
                                    if (inBounds(nx, ny) && unusable[nx][ny] == INF && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                                        unusable[nx][ny] = unusable[x][y] + 1;
                                        q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int x = 0; x < N; x++) {
            for (int y = 0; y < M; y++) {
                if (scientists[x].charAt(y) >= '1' && scientists[x].charAt(y) <= '9') {
                    addEdge(source, nodeID(x, y), scientists[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                if (reactors[x].charAt(y) >= '1' && reactors[x].charAt(y) <= '9') {
                    addEdge(N * N + nodeID(x, y), sink, reactors[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                }
                for (int X = 0; X < N; X++) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < M; Y++) {
                        if (scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' ||
                            reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z') {
                            continue;
                        }
                        for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
                            Arrays.fill(vis[i], 0);
                        }
                        Queue<int[]> bq = new LinkedList<>();
                        bq.offer(new int[]{x, y, 1});
                        vis[x][y] = 1;
                        boolean found = false;
                        while (!bq.isEmpty()) {
                            int[] cell = bq.poll();
                            int cx = cell[0], cy = cell[1], t = cell[2];
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                vis[cx][cy] = 1;
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (t >= unusable[cx][cy] || t >= T) continue;
                            for (int di = -1; di <= 1; di++) {
                                for (int dj = -1; dj <= 1; dj++) {
                                    if (Math.abs(di) + Math.abs(dj) == 1) {
                                        int nx = cx + di, ny = cy + dj;
                                        if (inBounds(nx, ny) && vis[nx][ny] == 0 &&
                                            scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' &&
                                            t + 1 <= unusable[nx][ny]) {
                                            vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                                            bq.offer(new int[]{nx, ny, t + 1});
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (found) {
                            addEdge(nodeID(x, y), N * N + nodeID(X, Y), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(dinic());
    }
}
